people.imagined: The gate at the hour the mist comes in. He stands so still in the grey that the viewer almost walks past him; then the eyes move. He has been standing there a long time with the paper of the month's page folded in his sleeve and has no wish to be seen.
people.subject: The moment: standing motionless in thick mist at a gate, almost merged with it, he lets only his eyes turn toward the viewer. Face, most important: an utterly unremarkable thin grey face, the kind that is forgotten at once: skin the colour of ash, narrow cheeks, a small straight nose, thin colourless lips, eyebrows so pale they nearly vanish; pale grey eyes that give nothing back. Hair: thin grey, combed flat, tied in a plain small knot under his hat. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, held very still. Clothing: a long grey-green oiled cloak with a hood pushed back, dull and damp-sheened, buttoned to the throat; a wide round bamboo hat with a cord under his chin; the cloth is well kept and without any badge. Hands and objects: both hands hidden inside the cloak; from beneath it a pole shows, its top holding a small black-pine lantern with horn panes, the candle dim. Beads of mist hang on the brim of his hat and on the grey cloth of his shoulders, so that he seems made of the same stuff as the air. Background: heavy white mist, with the faint grey outline of a stone gatepost. Light: soft grey diffuse light from the upper left, flattening everything; no shadows. A faint blue-green Water and Wood hint in the mist. Expression: blank and watchful, practised at being overlooked.

people.imagined: A night camp at the Bobtail ridge's foot. He is laughing at something a guard said, head thrown back, the axe across his knees, and the laugh carries across the clearing; then he catches himself and picks up a child's primer from his lap, as if it were a tally.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a camp fire at night, he laughs hugely with his head back, then glances down at a small book on his knee. Face, most important: a huge laugh, mouth wide open showing a missing upper tooth and the grey in his beard; a heavy, scarred face, a thick white scar cutting through the left eyebrow and another across the nose, a flattened broken nose, a thick neck, small bright dark eyes creased shut. Hair: coarse black streaked with grey, in a messy tied knot, a few strands loose. Body: massive, thick as a barrel, with a short neck and arms like beams. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak thrown back from the shoulders, a dark-grey tunic stretched across the chest; a leather belt; a wide bamboo hat hanging at his back. Hands and objects: an axe with a pale lynx-bone haft across his knees, the head dark and curved; on his thigh, a thin child's primer with a faded blue cover, open. The fire throws his huge shadow up the trunks behind him; a few sparks float up past a half-eaten flatbread and a pile of split kindling. Background: a dark pine wood, a pale pole lantern. Light: orange firelight from below and the left, deep shadow behind. Faint blue-green hint of Wood and Water. Expression: boisterous, then caught out.

people.imagined: The lantern cellar at night. She is trimming a green-paned lantern and has looked up at a stranger on the stair, giving them a second long look; ink on her fingers, a lamp wick burning low. She is deciding whether to be kind to a stranger or add them to the ledger.
people.subject: The moment: in a cellar, she holds a green-paned lantern up beside her face and looks at the viewer a second time, harder. Face, most important: ink stains plainly visible on her long fingers and the heel of her right hand, near her cheek, dark blue-black; a long, severe, handsome face, high cheekbones, a long straight nose, thin firm mouth; her eyes dark and narrowed with suspicion, lines of fine wear round them. Hair: black with a streak of white at the right temple, drawn into a tight high knot with a plain wooden pin. Body: tall, narrow, upright and stiff. Clothing: a long grey-green oiled cloak over a dark-grey tunic with a buttoned high collar; a dark sash; sleeve cuffs pinned back with small bone clips. Hands and objects: the lantern has four panes of green glass and a black iron frame, and its light tints the left side of her face green; her left hand grips the pole. Background: a blurred stone cellar wall lined with shelves of other lanterns. A narrow stair of stone climbs behind her, with a row of small lanterns flickering at different heights. Light: green lantern glow and a warm lamp from the upper left. Hint of green Wood. Expression: suspicious, intent, unforgiving.

people.imagined: Spring, holding the lantern for the head at the gate. She smiles at everyone and listens; her fingers watch the head's hands and she counts the turns. She has just heard something she will repeat.
people.subject: The moment: holding a lantern aloft by the gate, she smiles warmly at the viewer, listening, while her eyes drift to something just out of frame. Face, most important: a comely, round, gentle face, smooth cheeks with a dimple, soft full lips in a ready smile, large clear dark eyes under delicate arched brows, and a tiny mole beside the mouth; she looks like someone everyone confides in. Hair: glossy black, in a low knot at the nape with a single white pear-wood pin. Body: slim, graceful, standing straight. Clothing: an undyed pale linen robe with a crossed collar and long sleeves, tied with a dark-green sash, over which she wears a short grey-green oiled cape, clean and unstained; no badge. Hands and objects: both hands lift a pole-lantern with horn panes and a black frame; her fingers on the pole are bent in a counting position, thumb pressing on three fingertips in turn. Background: a blurred wooden gate and mist. Beyond her on the gatepost a small carved mist-seal, and in the mist a faint grey figure of the head working at the array. Light: warm lantern gold from the upper left. Faint blue-green Water hint. Expression: sweet, attentive, with something held back behind it.

people.imagined: At the port road beside a cart, he is promising a merchant something cheerful and it comes out smoothly. The silver tooth shows in the half-light; he does not know how obvious it is.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside cart, he grins broadly and spreads a hand as if offering a deal, a slight forward lean toward the viewer. Face, most important: a gleaming silver tooth plainly shown in the middle of his grin, one upper incisor bright as a coin among the yellow ones; a wide, pliant face, flat cheeks, a bulbous nose, a thin little moustache, eyes quick and merry and not quite meeting yours; a few chins. His eyebrows are thin and arched, his cheeks have a shine of sweat, and tiny fine veins show across the nose. Hair: black, greased back under a wide bamboo hat tipped back on his head. Body: heavy, round-shouldered, the posture of a carter. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak thrown back over a brown quilted jacket with frogged cord fastenings; a fat string of copper coins hangs at his belt. A string of copper coins hangs from his belt in loops and a small leather purse is tied to it; beneath the oiled cloak his quilted jacket is stained at the cuffs with fish brine, and his straw sandals are tied with cord. Hands and objects: his open right palm held out; his left holds the rope of a lantern on a pole. Background: blurred wooden cart wheel, stacked salt-fish baskets, mist. Behind him a loaded cart with a canvas cover, a stack of wicker baskets of dried silver fish, a shaggy brown ox, and a lamp post at a crossroad vanishing into white mist. Light: warm light from the upper left. A faint green Wood hint. The light is low and soft, a pearly grey morning haze with a warm yellow shine along the edge of the silver tooth and the coins. Expression: easy, ingratiating, calculating.

people.imagined: At a crossroads at dusk, lighting the lantern on its post. A door slams somewhere down the road and he flinches visibly, then pretends to be adjusting the wick.
people.subject: The moment: at a crossroads lantern post at dusk, he flinches and jerks his head toward a sound out of frame, the lighting taper still lit in his hand. Face, most important: a flinch: his eyes snapped wide, whites showing all round, mouth tight, shoulder hunched up to the ear; a gaunt, hollow-cheeked, lined face, long drooping nose, thin grey stubble, deep dark rings under the eyes. Hair: dry grey, cropped short, sticking up in tufts. His hair is thin on top and a few long strands lie damp across his brow. Body: thin, wiry, coiled like a spring. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak dark with damp at the hem, a hood, a dark-grey tunic buttoned tight; a plain bamboo hat hanging at his back. His hat is pushed back on his head and tied with a plain cord; the oiled cloak has two long dark stains of lamp oil down the front, and the tunic's collar is buttoned to the chin, the knuckles of his hands scraped raw from the lantern chains. Hands and objects: a long lighting taper with a tiny flame in his right hand, the left holding a half-open lantern with frosted horn panes and a bundle of small fee-tallies on knotted cord at his belt. Background: Behind him a tall post carrying five lanterns on iron arms, the glass of each one of a different pale colour, and four roads running away into the dusk between dark tea bushes. Light: The lantern flame lights half of the face a hot orange while the other half stays in cold blue shadow, making the whites of his eyes shine, from the lower right. Faint blue-green hint. Expression: tense, watchful, ready for betrayal.

people.imagined: Leading the salt-fish carts at dawn. A child is walking the road alone; he has stopped the whole line to give her a rice ball and has paid her fee. He is calm and does not make a thing of it; rice crumbs are on his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty road at dawn, he leans down from the lead cart and holds out a rice ball in his open hand, smiling gently. Face, most important: a kind, broad, weathered face, round and tanned, with soft crow's-feet and laugh-lines, a big warm nose, a gentle slow smile; small lively eyes like a bird's; rice crumbs clinging at the corner of his mouth and on his beard. Hair: grey-black, a thin knot, half covered by a wide bamboo hat pushed back. Body: stout, sturdy, easy in the seat of the cart. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, open, over a faded blue quilted jacket; rice crumbs on the sleeve and in the folds of the cloak; a copper coin on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: in his right hand a small white rice ball wrapped in a bamboo leaf; at the cart's side a lantern on a pole, still lit. Background: a blurred cart with wicker baskets and a misty road. Behind him a line of carts disappears into the mist, each with a small lantern, and a small barefoot girl stands at the roadside holding a stick. Light: pale gold dawn from the upper left. Blue Water hint. Expression: generous, calm and unhurried.

people.imagined: The Forest of Lost Mist, a morning. She has just laid a fresh bank of mist and stands in the middle of it, hand lifted, as the white closes behind her. She has noticed her pegs have moved again and her fog-coloured eyes have narrowed.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a swirling bank of mist she has just laid, one hand raised, she looks straight at the viewer with cold appraisal. Face, most important: unusual pale grey eyes the colour of fog, nearly colourless, wide and cold; a narrow, sharp, arrogant face, a thin straight nose, a high forehead, a small tight smirk, skin fair and cool. Her skin is very pale, nearly translucent, with fine blue veins at the temples; her lashes are long and so fair that they almost vanish against the grey eyes. Hair: black, in a long high ponytail, a few loose strands. Body: slim, straight, chin high. Clothing: a well-cut grey-green oiled cloak, trim and close fitted, over a dark-grey tunic with black piping at the collar; a narrow dark sash; a wide bamboo hat hanging at her back. A thin silver chain with a small wooden mist-peg charm hangs at her throat; her cloak is lined in dove-grey silk, and she wears black gloves of soft leather, the left one with a cut finger. Hands and objects: her right hand raised palm-out with white mist curling between the fingers; at her feet, a short peg of dark wood with a twist of cord. Background: At her feet three short wooden pegs with cords stand in the white mist, set in a precise triangle, and beyond them dark tree trunks lose themselves in the fog. Light: There are no hard shadows anywhere; the fog turns the whole picture into pearl and silver, and her pale eyes are the only point that seems to hold the light, from the upper left. Faint blue-green Water and Wood hint. Expression: arrogant, cool and ambitious.

people.imagined: After a lost round, at the edge of the forest, he combs his parting back into place with his fingers. A few frost-bitten toes stiffen under the wrap on one foot; he pretends he has not been beaten.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the forest's edge, he combs a hand across his hair to straighten his parting and looks at the viewer with an overly composed face. Face, most important: a perfectly neat, ruler-straight side parting in his glossy black hair, the comb in hand; a handsome, narrow, tidy face, a smooth high forehead, a thin line of mouth, ambitious light-brown eyes held too level, a small tic in the jaw. A small crescent of dried mud sits on his cheekbone, and the corner of his mouth is pulled thin and tight in suppressed annoyance. Hair: glossy black, oiled, bound in a precise topknot. Body: slim, upright, a stiffness in the left leg. He favours his left foot, which is wrapped in bandage under the boot, and he stands with his weight shifted off it. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, brushed clean, over a dark-grey tunic; a single round pewter button at the collar; a bamboo hat held under one arm. A pale grey scarf is wound neatly twice around his neck and tucked under the cloak; the cloak's hem is stained with bog water to the knee, and the boots, though cleaned, are cracked at the toes. Hands and objects: a small wooden comb in his right hand; a peg of dark wood with a cord in his left. Background: blurred mist and dark pines. At the edge of the forest the white mist rolls out across dark wet grass, and a few wooden pegs lean crookedly in the bog, pulled out of line. Light: pale morning light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The sky is a flat pale white and the light falls evenly, so that nothing shines but the little pewter button and the oiled sheen of the cloak. Expression: composed over wounded pride.

people.imagined: On the Đồng Sơn road with a fellow guard who is cursing the ridge. He listens, rubbing the boar-tusk charm with his thumb because someone just said a lie, and wears a careful blank face.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a road post, he rubs a charm and looks sidelong at the viewer, careful and still. Face, most important: a small curved boar-tusk charm, yellow-white and the length of a finger, at his chest, rubbed shiny, held in a closed fist; a wary, lean, sun-browned face, wiry stubble on a narrow jaw, a pale scar through one eyebrow, a crooked nose, dark eyes that slide sideways. His beard is patchy and coarse, there is a healed notch in his upper lip, and one of his front teeth is missing; the eyes are black and ringed with fine lines. Hair: tangled dark brown, cut short with a knife and held with a rag. A stub of cord trails from the rag, the ends of the hair cut short with a knife. Body: lithe, narrow, balanced on the balls of his feet. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, borrowed and a little large, over a dark-grey tunic; leather wrist wraps; straw sandals. The borrowed cloak has a sleeve pinned up with a bone pin and is stiff with dried mud at the hem; underneath, his tunic is of three different greys, cut from three borrowed pieces, and a short knife with a bone handle is tucked in his belt. Hands and objects: the tusk charm hangs on a dark cord; a short pole with a lantern in his left hand. Background: Behind him a pole lantern burns at a bend in the road, a pile of grey stones, a dark ridge of scrub and the first pale line of dawn. Light: The grey dawn is cold and even, with a warm spot of lantern light on one cheek and the polished yellow of the tusk, from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: cautious, giving nothing away.

people.imagined: At a milestone at night with a folded page in his sleeve. He has read it, and the mace scar over his brow is pale in the lantern's glow; the thin wrists stick out of the cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a milestone at night, he holds a folded paper to his chest and stares past the viewer, jaw tight. Face, most important: a long, pale, jagged mace scar curving over the left eyebrow, shiny and raised, the eyebrow split in two; a thin young face, hollow cheeks, narrow chin, dark eyes bright with a cold grievance; chapped lips. A day's stubble of boyish fuzz darkens his chin, the nostrils are slightly flared, and a long silver-white seam of an old burn runs along his jaw below the ear. Hair: black, short and uneven, with a long bang across the scarred brow. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, boyish, very thin wrists sticking out of cuffs a size too short. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, too big at the shoulders, over a dark-grey tunic; a hat hanging at his back. The cloak hangs to his ankles and is pinned at the neck with a thorn; under it the grey tunic is clean, plain and a size too small, short at the wrists, and a leather strap crosses his chest holding a thin satchel. Hands and objects: a small folded paper held tight in his right hand; his left grips a lantern pole. Background: The milestone is cut with a round pattern of nested curved lines that look like waves of mist, and behind it a long straight road runs between black pines to a thin line of pale sky. Light: a single warm lantern from the upper left, deep blue night. Blue Water hint. The lantern flame is steady and warm, lighting the scar over his eyebrow and making the whites of his eyes glitter, while the road behind lies in deep indigo. Expression: vengeful, tight, suspicious.

people.imagined: Carrying a lantern on the Phù Kiều road at dusk. She has stopped to rest her hands and holds them up to look at the blisters; she isn't angry at anyone and her face is quiet.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a riverside road, she holds her two open hands up before her, palms toward the viewer, looking at them, and then up with a gentle smile. Face, most important: rings of pale, shiny lantern blisters round every finger, clearly visible, each finger ringed like a small band; a soft round young face, a gentle small nose, a warm mouth, big dark forgiving eyes, a bruise-brown shadow under them. A faint dusting of freckles crosses her nose, her lashes are wet as if she has just wept and stopped, and there is a small rice-powder smudge on her chin. Hair: black, in a single long braid over one shoulder with a green thread tied in it. Body: slight, small, soft shoulders. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, a size large, over a plain grey tunic; a bamboo hat on her back. Round her neck a little green cord holds a lotus seed bead; the cloak is stained at the hem by river water and hangs open, with the wide bamboo hat pushed back and the cord resting at her throat. Hands and objects: a pole lantern with a frosted shade stands against her shoulder, lit. Background: blurred willow and river, dusk. Behind her a willow droops over a slow green river, a low arched stone bridge, and a milestone with a pale carving; a single pole lantern burns by the road. Light: soft amber lantern light from the upper left, blue-violet dusk. Faint blue Water hint. The sky is a deep violet with a strip of orange at the horizon, and the lantern throws a small amber pool on her face and hands. Expression: peaceable, humble, forgiving.

people.imagined: Kneeling at a milestone in spring, he has recut the seal again and is checking the chisel edge. It slipped, just now, and he is looking at the line, afraid.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a half-carved milestone, he looks up with a worried frown from a chisel in his hand. Face, most important: a plain, honest, round face, thick brows, a flat nose, dust whitening his hair and cheeks; worried brown eyes; a small cut on his lip. A pale line of dried sweat runs through the dust on his cheek, his lower lip is bitten raw, and the whites of his eyes are red from stone grit. Hair: brown and short, so thick with grey stone dust in the hair and eyebrows that he looks as if he has aged forty years. Body: stocky, broad hands, kneeling. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak thrown over one shoulder; a leather apron over a grey tunic; sleeves rolled. The grey oiled cloak is folded under his knees as a cushion and grey with dust; the leather apron is scored with chisel scratches, a bundle of spare chisels in a canvas roll sits beside him, and his sleeves are rolled above muscular forearms. Hands and objects: the heel of his right hand shows several short pink healed chisel nicks in a row; a steel chisel and a wooden mallet; before him a pale grey milestone with a half-cut round mist-seal pattern of nested curved lines. Background: The milestone is as tall as his chest, pale and slightly crooked, with half of the round mist-seal carved and the other half only a scratched outline; beyond it a roadside bank of green fern and a line of dark pines. Light: bright gentle spring light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. The spring sunlight is clean, with sharp shadows in the carved grooves and a bright glint on the chisel edge. Expression: diligent and anxious.

people.imagined: At the quarry in glare, a stone slab before him, which he has been told to carve and has chosen instead to leave. He squints at the one he fancies. Dust whitens his lashes.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone slab in glare, he squints hard at the viewer, a mallet resting on his shoulder. Face, most important: pale stone dust plainly frosting both eyelashes and eyebrows white, so he looks lined in frost; a permanent squint, one eye nearly shut, deep crow's feet; a long dour face, a dust-grey stubble, a hooked nose, a mouth turned down. Deep vertical lines furrow between his brows, his ears are large and slightly red, and his cheeks are covered in a fine layer of pale dust that has settled in each wrinkle. Hair: black, cropped, whitened with dust. Body: lean, hunched, thick forearms. He stands with his legs apart and his back arched slightly backwards as if bracing against the glare. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, hitched up; a leather apron, pale with dust; rolled sleeves. The oiled cloak is hitched up through his belt on one side to free the leg, and his boots are scuffed white; at his hip hang a leather pouch of pegs and a plumb line with a small lead weight. Hands and objects: a mallet in his right hand; a short chisel; a half-carved milestone beside him with a spiral seal. Background: blurred quarry wall and glare. Behind him a quarry wall of pale grey stone cut in great steps, a row of rough blocks, a stone slab waiting on rollers, and a hard blue sky without a cloud. Light: bright, harsh white light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. The sun is high and bleaching, so the stone, the dust and his white lashes merge into a single glaring pale, with the hard black shadow of his hat under his chin. Expression: dour, arbitrary, absorbed.

people.imagined: At the guards' spring dinner, pouring tea from a big gourd into cups, talkative and cheerful, a tea-stained lip. She is counting in her head what she still lacks for the terrace.
people.subject: The moment: pouring tea from a gourd, she chatters happily to the viewer. Face, most important: a brown tea stain at one corner of her lower lip, plain and visible, a small dark mark like a drip; a round, cheerful, freckled face, a button nose, quick merry hazel eyes, a gap in her front teeth. Her cheeks are plump and flushed from the steam, her lashes short and curling, and a tiny dimple appears in her left cheek when she grins. Hair: brown, in two high buns with a green bamboo-leaf ribbon. Body: small, quick, plump. She bounces slightly on her feet as she pours, one hip against the table, the posture of a girl who talks while she works. Clothing: a clean grey-green oiled cloak, over a light-grey apron dress, sleeves tied back; a bamboo hat hanging at her back. A green ribbon ties back her sleeves, the grey-green cloak hangs on a hook behind her, and a fine splash of brown tea has stained her apron and the front of her tunic. Hands and objects: a large pale gourd, tilted, a brown stream falling into a clay cup; a wooden tray of cups. Background: Behind her a long table with rows of clay cups and wicker baskets of rice balls, guards in grey-green cloaks laughing, paper lanterns strung across the beams, and a cooking fire glowing. Light: Warm lantern light and fire glow fill the room with gold, shining on the wet curve of the gourd and the stream of tea, from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: gregarious, bright, honest.

people.imagined: Mid-afternoon, over her tea pot. She has yawned into its steam and her eyes are closing; the second pot has been forgotten and the tea is weak.
people.subject: The moment: yawning wide over a steaming teapot, eyes half shut. Face, most important: a huge yawn, mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut, steam curling across her face; a soft, round, sleepy face, a small snub nose, heavy lids, smooth tan skin, a slack cheek pillowed on her fist. A thread of steam beads her lashes and short hairs with water, and a small pink crease from the sleeve is pressed across her cheek. Hair: brown, coming loose from a lazy bun, a bamboo pin crooked. A bamboo hairpin hangs by a single strand of hair, and soft short hairs have escaped around her ears. Body: soft, slumped, leaning on the table. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak left open over a grey tunic with a crumpled collar; a bamboo hat dangling by its cord. Hands and objects: a round clay teapot with a thin plume of steam; a small cup, half full of pale tea. Background: blurred wooden hut wall and herb bundles. Behind her a rough shelf with a row of clay pots, bunches of dried leaves hung from the rafters, a basket of tea buds, and a window where a green terrace is visible. Light: warm hazy afternoon light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The afternoon sun slants through the window and turns the steam into a golden veil. Expression: calm, lazy, drowsy.

people.imagined: In the lantern cellar, trimming wicks, a cough catching in his throat from the smoke. He has soot ringed round his eyes like a badger and is beaming up at the viewer, unaware.
people.subject: The moment: trimming a lantern, he looks up with a happy trusting grin, coughing into his shoulder. Face, most important: thick black lamp-soot rings round both eyes, a clear dark mask like a badger's, against a pale face; a thin, narrow face, big shining dark eyes, a long neck, an eager open mouth; a few soot smears on the cheek. A long streak of black soot runs from his temple across his cheek, his nostrils are dusted dark, and his lips are dry and slightly cracked. Hair: black, fine, flopping over his forehead. Body: thin and frail, narrow chest, shoulders raised in a cough. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak, too big, over a soot-grey tunic; a wick-trimming apron. The cloak is held up by both hands of cord at the neck, and under it a plain grey tunic has black thumbprints around the collar and cuffs; he wears a necklace of a small brass key on a cord. Hands and objects: in one hand a tiny pair of silver scissors, in the other a lantern with green panes, the flame wavering. Background: The cellar has a low arched stone ceiling, shelves of lanterns of many shapes, jars of oil, and a ladder going up to a square of grey daylight. Light: Lamp glow gives his face a warm orange, the green panes throw a soft green on the wall behind him, and soot hangs as a faint haze in the air, from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Expression: trusting, sunny and fickle.

people.imagined: The Đồng Sơn road in 1050, the year of founding: he has just hung the first mist lantern at the crossroads and stands back to look at it, a carter's son pleased with the light.
people.subject: The moment: at a crossroads, he has hung a first lantern on its post and steps back with a quiet smile, looking up at it. Face, most important: a lined, kindly, long-jawed face weathered by river and road, a high narrow forehead, a wide generous mouth, a long grey-streaked beard to the chest, a nose crooked at the tip, tender, lively dark eyes. His teeth are uneven and one canine is crooked, and a line of deep sun creases runs from each eye towards the temples; a small white scar crosses the top of his left hand. Hair: grey-black, long, in a plain knot and a bamboo hat pushed to the back of his head. Body: tall, lean and loose, an easy stoop. Clothing: a long grey-green oiled cloak, spotless and well kept, over a dark-grey tunic; straw sandals. The bamboo hat is old and darkened by many rains, the cloak's cord is tied in a simple knot and its hem is stained by river mud, and he wears no jewellery of any kind. Hands and objects: his right hand holding a long pole whose head carries a lantern of black pine and horn panes. Background: Behind him a long pale road disappears into mist between pines, with a milestone not yet carved and a little river glinting at the foot of the hill. Light: Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks, from the upper left. The light is soft and evenly grey with a gold glow from the lantern on his weathered cheek. Expression: generous, forgiving, content.

people.imagined: The Đồng Sơn road, the night of 1190, holding the mist. He stands with an arm raised, calm, the mist streaming from his sleeve and a child behind him, his voice about to give him away.
people.subject: The moment: standing alone on a dark road, he raises one arm and looks forward steadily, a calm stranger holding mist. Face, most important: a calm, square, plain face, a short dark beard, steady eyes, a faint smile at the corner of the mouth, one deep line between the brows; skin brown, ordinary. His eyes are dark and quiet, a small scar notches his left eyebrow, and a weary shadow lies under each eye; sweat stands at his temples. Hair: black, tied back, under a bamboo hat. Body: sturdy, square, planted. He stands with his shoulders slightly rounded, the left foot a half step forward as if shielding someone behind him. Clothing: a grey-green oiled cloak flaring from the raised arm, over a dark-grey tunic. The cloak's hem is dark with mist and the hat's cord hangs loose at his shoulder; his tunic beneath is plain dark grey and carefully cut, and his sandals are tied with grass rope. Hands and objects: from his raised right sleeve a stream of pale white mist pours and curls; his left hand holds a lantern pole with a dim lantern. Background: Behind him a pale shape of a small child crouched at a milestone is just visible in the mist, with the dim yellow of a distant lantern. Light: Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks, from the upper left. The mist glows faintly white from within, and the lantern light touches the side of his face with a dull amber. Expression: calm, loyal, brave.
